title: SSE CR normalization: frame string is cloned unconditionally when CR present
description:
client.rs subscribe_events: CR normalization calls slice.replace("
","
").replace('','
') — two sequential String allocations when CR is present. A single-pass normalizer avoids the second allocation. Low impact for typical JMAP push traffic (low-frequency state changes) but measurable at 1 MiB frames.
